summary: Iteration 103 — validated currency rename (BigCoin/BC -> BigPoints), 12 flagship AI cover-art tiles, and real ad slots on Home (leaderboard + 2 in-feed). Backend + Web frontend both pass. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: shell.py flagship list: query uses `flagship_slug: {$ne: null}` without an explicit sort — 12 tiles come out alpha-ish by insertion but there is no deterministic ordering; consider adding .sort() for stable order if editorial ranking matters.

banner_ads_v2.py: `_house_idx` is a module-level dict mutated per-request — under a multi-worker deployment (uvicorn --workers>1) rotation state will diverge per worker. Not a bug now but worth noting for horizontal scale.

Home shelf `home-your-stations` renders only 4 tiles (with SEE ALL) while backend returns 12; this appears intentional but ensure product intent matches (spec says '12 flagships now have on-brand AI cover art' — verified via API, only 4 visible on Home shelf).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria in review_request verified as PASS. Backend: GET /api/shell/summary -> 12 flagships each with static.prod-images JPEG art URL (no ui-avatars). GET /api/ads/banner/decision authed for slot_key=top_leaderboard, featured_horizontal, mid_horizontal all return source='house' with headline+sub_text (no slot_not_found). Frontend at /: ad-leaderboard, ad-infeed, ad-infeed-2 all render with 'AD' label + house creatives (variants observed: 'Pick your AI radio host', 'Win concert tickets weekly', 'Coffee on your route'). home-your-stations shelf renders 4 station-tile-img-* elements, all with naturalWidth=1024 real JPEGs, 0 ui-avatars placeholders. /wallet page: title 'BigPoints Wallet', body contains 'BigPoints', no 'BigCoin', no standalone ' BC '. /trivia and /passport: BigPoints present, no BigCoin/BC. Regression: theme-toggle flips html[data-theme] from dark->light and persists after reload; shell-filter-chips renders live counts (Radio 14, Eat 5, Salons 2, Fitness 1, Shops 3, Games 3, Offers 11, World 5,021); sidebar nav sections (DISCOVER, REWARDS, FLAGSHIPS · 12) intact. Console noise: only pre-auth 401s on /api/auth/me & /api/takeovers/current + a couple 404s on non-critical assets — documented as acceptable in review_request. No crashes.
